### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

```


```{r map predictions}

#------------------------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for all treatment arms
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)

# NOW, we loop through each district and make maps
#------------------------------------------------------

map_mort_tx0_districts <- list()
map_mort_tx1_districts <- list()
map_mort_diff_districts <- list()
map_mort_probeff_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  map_mort_tx0_districts[[i]] <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_districts[[i]],
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "A. Control (Placebo + Infant Azithro)")
  
  # map_mort_tx1_districts[[i]] <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_districts[[i]],
  #                              agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
  #                              tagtxt  = "B. Treatment (Child Azithro)")
  
  # map_mort_diff_districts[[i]] <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_districts[[i]],
  #                              agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
  #                              tagtxt  = "C. ATE",
  #                              min = -5, max = -1,
  #                              paletteopt = 2,
  #                              legtxt = "ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years")
  
  # map_mort_probeff_districts[[i]] <- create_mort_map(raster2 = sims_mort_probeff_raster2,
  #                              agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
  #                              tagtxt  = "D. Bayesian Results",
  #                              min = 0.5, max = 0.75,
  #                              paletteopt = 3,
  #                              legtxt = "Posterior Pr(mortality ATE < 0)")
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$map_mort_tx0 <- map_mort_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$map_mort_tx1 <- map_mort_tx1_districts
results_spaMM_districts$map_mort_diff <- map_mort_diff_districts
# results_spaMM_districts$map_mort_probeff<- map_mort_probeff_districts


```

### Preview maps
```{r}

map_mort_child <- 
  ggarrange(map_mort_tx0_child, 
            map_mort_tx1_child,
            map_mort_diff_child,
            map_mort_probeff_child,
            nrow = 2, ncol = 2)

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels/avenir-spatial-ATE-map-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_mort_child,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 250,
       height = 320,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels/avenir-spatial-ATE-map-",Sys.Date(),".png"),
       map_mort_child,
       device = "png", 
       width = 250,
       height = 320,
       units = "mm")

save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))
# Note to self: data-2024-12-10.RData has the simulate() results.

```
